resolvedQuestions.question: Which failures were latent while the CLI was only a fallback and surfaced solely because it became the primary path?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Eight latent defects/exposures named at file with hiding mechanisms: socket-scope probe (fallback.js, probed flat path vs sha256(dbDir) scope dir — always socket_absent), 250ms budget clamp under ~440ms warm latency, ~30s wait on immediately-knowable unreachable daemon, warm-only default refusing cold spawn via prompt-time env marker (no brief at all; fixed via --no-warm-only), env-block config carried inside MCP declarations (rehomed to REPO_ENV_DEFAULTS), cross-package shim hardcoding the renamed path (spec-kit TARGET_REL), MCP Server object being the socket's request handler not a transport, plus three harness-level latents: invalid frozen parity inputs, 4-suite sampling hiding 48 failures, documented --convergence-mode flag never bound.

resolvedQuestions.question: What classes of residue does transport removal leave beyond name references, and which did the sweep miss?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Eleven grounded classes: assertion residue (claims naming neither retired token — THE missed class, 8 surfaces found by hunting claims), corpus-outside residue (87 live files incl. .github working-directory — residue that executes), printed-command residue, diagnostic false-negatives, test/fixture residue, name-outlived-referent kept-by-constraint, generated-artifact residue (regenerate don't edit), evidence residue (fixing = falsification), negative-guard residue (keep), packet-record residue (incl. cross-loop: uncommitted artifacts revert the next lineage), retrieval-vocabulary residue. Bucketing rule: historical=leave, live=rewrite, guard=keep, generated=regenerate, operator-name=keep deliberately.

resolvedQuestions.question: What repeatable checklist should the next transport-to-CLI migration use, ordered by cost of failure prevented?
resolvedQuestions.answer: 21 steps in five phases: (A) map what the transport silently carries — reconciled inventory, lift env config, trace the real registered path, decide residency by measurement and name what starts it; (B) prove replacement while old is live — frozen wire contract, parity on validated frozen inputs, resilience moved behind new door first, exercise fallback in every dependency state; (C) rewire then delete stopping on surprise — callers+helpers proven, dependents handed to the deletion, halt on load-bearing surfaces, rename after removal; (D) sweep by claims over the whole repo with written keep-classes; (E) verify from final state — full suite, inverted guards, one-worktree real-path measurement, honest record, flags-that-bind.

resolvedQuestions.question: What exactly shipped and which ordering invariants made it safe?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Replacement proven (003 parity: 22 frozen cases, 7 matched, 15 named-allowlisted, 0 differed) before callers rewired (004) before transport deleted (005) before rename (006). Ordering load-bearing: nothing deleted until replacement proven; rename waits so the move diff stays mechanical.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which residue hits are legitimate historical records vs live surfaces?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Bucketing verified on live tree: 820 files carry the old path, 0 outside specs/changelog/benchmark — AC-007 closure holds. Keep-classes: changelogs/dated benchmarks/frozen fixtures/run-records (evidence), negative-guard tests (guards), packet docs (records), sweep's own docs (must name what they hunted), operator-visible names (constraint).

keyFindings.finding: The observable signature of the worst failure looked like success: the warm-only cold-spawn refusal produced a 209ms hook read as an improvement until the work was found missing.
Every latent failure sat on a path the healthy system never took; promotion made the untraveled path load-bearing.
The token sweep missed assertion residue (claims naming neither retired token) and corpus-outside wiring (.github working-directory); sibling packet independently hit the same two.
Residue count != hit count: keep-by-design classes (evidence, guards, operator names, generated artifacts) mean the correct action on most surviving hits is inaction.
A literal-zero acceptance criterion is unfalsifiable once kept evidence exists; write the buckets into the criterion (live-zero).
Uncommitted loop output is a landmine for the next loop — 19 leftover paths reverted a research lineage via write containment; commit each loop's artifacts before starting the next.
Move resilience behind the new front door before repointing callers, and exercise the fallback in every dependency state before it becomes primary.
When a removal surface proves load-bearing (MCP Server = socket request handler), halt and reopen the phase rather than work around it.
Audit that harness flags bind: --convergence-mode was documented but never read; an equivalent flag's identical behavior hid it; the repaired code's comment records the mechanism.

The sibling memory-decommission independently produced the same taxonomy (214 claim-hits in 115 live files post-sweep; code seams broken; literal-zero criterion amended) — the lessons generalize within this repo.
